sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1.

By way of this petition, the petitioner has prayed for following reliefs:
"A. Be pleased to issue a writ of mandamus, writ in the nature of mandamus, or any other appropriate writ, order or directing quashing and setting aside the impugned notices dated 30.11.19 and 31.12.19 (Annexure A (colly)) issued by the respondent no 2 by holding the same as illegal, unconstitutional and against the order passed by this Hon'ble Court in SCA no 11138 of 2013 dated 21.01.14.

Mohammedsafi Mohammedhanif Qureshi @ ... vs State Of Gujarat on 5 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29365090/
1 B. That the respondent no 2 and its agents and officers be directed not to harass and disturb the present petitioner from carrying out his lawful business of selling the ready made meat-mutton NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/1444/2020 ORDER DATED: 05/01/2023 undefined as per the order of the Hon'ble Court dated 21.01.14 passed in SCA no 11138 of 2013 and implement the order dated 21.01.14.
C.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Be pleased to award the cost of the present petition.
D. Any other and further relief in the interest of justice may kindly granted."

2.1 The case of the petitioner is that petitioner is selling meat and mutton in premises situated Plot No. 45, Chhapra Indiranagar Area of Section 24 of Gandhinagar City since last more than 20 years.
The petitioner applied for license to sell meat on 15.12.2008 and once again made application for the license on 09.08.2010.

2.2 Since license was not given to the petitioner, thrice petitioner preferred Special Civil Application No.13431 of 2008 decided on 12.11.2008, Special Civil Application No.8749 of 2010 dated 30.07.2010 and Special Civil Application No.11138 of 2013 dated 21.01.2014.

All these three petitions were disposed of or withdrawn as the direction to the respondent NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/1444/2020 ORDER DATED: 05/01/2023 undefined authorities to consider the representation that the petitioner may make in accordance with law as expeditiously as possible.

2.3 The last order passed by this Court in Special Civil Application No.11138 of 2013 on 21.01.2014,
more particularly in paras:3 and 4, the Court issued directions as under:
"3. It is the case of the petitioner that he is carrying on the business in accordance with the order passed by this Court on 03/10/2013.

Hence, following order: "Respondent No.2 is hereby directed to decide the application filed by the petitioner as expeditiously as possible and preferably within a period of four months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.

Till the application of the petitioner is decided, respondent authority shall not obstruct and/or harass the petitioner from carrying out the business of selling ready-made meat and subject to maintaining hygienic condition,
as observed in the order dated 3/10/2013.
4. In view of the above observations, Mr.Qureshi, learned advocate for the petitioner does not press this petition.
Hence, the present petition is disposed of as not pressed.
Notice is discharged."

2.4 It seems that though the respondent Corporation NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/1444/2020 ORDER DATED: 05/01/2023 undefined was directed to decide the application of the petitioner within a period of four months, the respondent Corporation has not decided application for issuance of license till today though the petitioner made representations on 05.02.2014 10.06.2015 and 05.12.2019.
2.5

In the meantime, pursuant to the Court's order, petitioner continued to sell mutton, fish and other non- veg items and, therefore, he was served with the notice dated 30.11.2019 and 31.12.2019 Mohammedsafi Mohammedhanif Qureshi @ ... vs State Of Gujarat on 5 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29365090/
2 asking him to stop selling of meat illegally without license, permission or registration.

sentences.text: The aforesaid notice is subject matter of challenge by way of this petition.
3.1 The Coordinate Bench vide order dated 06.12.2012 directed the petitioner to produce on record his application for grant of license preferred before the concerned authority.

3.2 Pursuant to the aforesaid direction, petitioner has produced the application for grant of license for sale of mutton dated 15.12.2008 and 09.08.2010 and also an NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/1444/2020 ORDER DATED: 05/01/2023 undefined order dated 17.09.2010 wherein the Deputy Municipal Commissioner, Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation has replied to the petitioner that the Corporation is in process of framing rules / policy for sale of fish, mutton and poltary items once the policy is framed or the rules are approved, the procedure for issuance of license will take place.
3.3 However, fact remains that till the date the application of the petitioner has remained undecided.

4. Learned advocate Mr.Qureshi drew attention of this Court to the earlier order passed by this Court directing the Corporation to decide the representation of the petitioner and to permit him to sell the mutton till his application for license is decided and requested that an order be passed on similar lines and petition be decided.

5.1 Learned advocate Mr.Devang Bhatt appearing for learned advocate Mr.H.S.Munshaw for Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation drew attention of this Court to the affidavit-in-reply filed by the Designated Officer, NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/1444/2020 ORDER DATED: 05/01/2023 undefined Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation dated 05.07.2022 and more particularly para:6 of the said reply wherein it is stated that the petitioner is having meat shop in a residential premises in Sector 24 of Gandhinagar without any permission under the Law and the Rules framed thereunder and, therefore, petitioner was served with notices for violation of Section 63 of the Food and Safety Standard Act, 2006 ['the Act', for short].

The affidavit also states that complaints are received from the citizens also to the effect that considering the situation prevailing at the time of filing of affidavit,
such business should not run in the residential premises.
5.2 In view of aforesaid affidavit-in-reply, learned advocate Mr.Devang Bhatt for learned advocate Mr.Munshaw prays for dismissal of this petition.
6. Heard learned advocates for the parties and perused the record.
I have considered the fact that the petitioner is running a mutton shop in a premises at Sector 24 of Gandhinagar in residential premises.

However, according to learned advocate Mr.Kureshi, NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/1444/2020 ORDER DATED: 05/01/2023 undefined sale of mutton and fish in residential premises is not prohibited as the petitioner is reselling the mutton after purchasing it from registered slaughter house at Ahmedabad and Kalol.

sentences.text: Considering the fact that the application made by the petitioner for seeking permission / license for selling of meat, fish and other non-veg items has never been decided by the authority and also considering the fact that the petitioner himself has produced on record the application for seeking permission to sell mutton and other non-veg items in the year 2010, interest of justice would be served if the petitioner is directed to prefer a fresh application seeking license for selling mutton and other non-veg items and if that application is decided by the respondent authority within a period of twelve weeks on receipt the application.
Such application seeking license must be made by the petitioner within two weeks from today.
Once the aforesaid application is received, the authority is directed to consider the same and decide it in accordance with law within a period of twelve weeks NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/1444/2020 ORDER
DATED: 05/01/2023 undefined from the date of receipt of such application.
8. With the aforesaid observations and directions, the present petition is disposed of.

(NIRZAR S. DESAI,J) MISHRA AMIT V.
